en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a busy European city street lined with multi‑storey brick townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the broad street. In the distance, two church spires and a larger church building dominate the skyline. Handwritten text is visible along the right margin, and printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.
